sections: The causal order of the parts

blocks.md: This lesson follows **Book Organization** in *Introduction* (Vol III).

Improving a model's proposals does not grant it permission to run a shell command, and sandboxing a tool call does not stop a fifty-turn trajectory from drifting off course or losing its state on a crash. Because none of the layers of the stochastic computer map (a later section) can do another layer's job, the parts of this book follow those layers in dependency order. Each part builds on the guarantees beneath it and closes one exposure before the pieces assemble into a complete runtime.

options: Under retry-until-accept, C_eff = E[C_attempt]/p_acc, so acceptance divides the whole attempt cost and any mechanism pays for its overhead only if it lowers this ratio.

A task's coordinate is its horizon H in turns, carried state S0 to S3, and authority A0 to A3, each level set by operational consequence rather than command syntax, and the coordinate names the exposure that closure must answer.
A model-directed loop is justified only where open-ended evidence must be interpreted and it raises acceptance by more than it inflates attempt cost under the same contract and verifier.

Authority levels A0 to A3 (read-only, disposable workspace, compensable, irreversible) classify an action by its consequence in the environment, and the same command can change class when the environment changes.
